features: ✅ 【Dolby Surround Sound | Built-in Google TV】: Unlike other mini portable projectors limited to Netflix or a few apps, the Crossbeats Solis Outdoor Projector 4K comes with Google TV built-in, unlocking 10,000+ apps and 800+ channels. Stream Netflix, YouTube, Jio Cinema, Hotstar, Prime Video, Zee5, and more—no extra streaming stick required. The Google Play Store ensures your apps are always up to date with the latest features. Simply plug in and start watching.

✅ 【Intelligent Voice Control | Smarter Living Made Easy】: With Google Assistant, just press the button on the remote, speak naturally, and it instantly finds what you want. This 4K Ultra HD projector with WiFi and Bluetooth supports multiple user accounts and personalized watchlists for a custom viewing experience. Google Cast allows instant wireless streaming from Android and iOS devices, while Kids Mode with filters ensures safe entertainment for families.

✅ 【1000 ANSI Brightness | Native 1080P with 4K Support】: Boasting 1000 ANSI and a cinema-grade LCD optical engine, the Solis Projector delivers native 1080P clarity with 4K support. With HDR10+ optimization, 99% color gamut coverage, reduced blue light, and 25% improved dark-scene detail compared to others in its class, it ensures stunning visuals even in bright rooms. Ideal for movies, gaming, outdoor parties, and live sports.

✅ 【 Auto Keystone | Electric Focus | 100%–50% Zoom】: The Solis Projector features auto keystone correction for quick adjustments and electric focus for sharp clarity. Its digital zoom (35%–100%) lets you resize the screen effortlessly with the remote making your home theatre setup simple and convenient.

✅ The first 4k full HD projector on the market to adopt an independent speaker stand design. The unique 30W audio-visual separation speaker stand not only brings cinema-level sound effects but also extends the lifespan. This bluetooth projector is equipped with ultra-high-speed Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.4
